rulings.Rulings: Matter on calendar for Thursday, July 09, 2026, Line 7, DEFENDANT IRA SHARLIP, M.D., GOLDEN GATE UROLOGY, INC.'s MOTION TO STRIKE Amended COMPLAINT. (Complete tentative ruling e-mailed to the parties). 2 - It is improper for Plaintiff to include a claim for punitive damages against a health care provider in any complaint prior to obtaining a court order authorizing inclusion of a claim for punitive damages. (Code of Civil Procedure section 425.13(a)) Plaintiff's Second Amended Complaint (SAC) seeks an award of punitive damages against the Defendants. The SAC contains lengthy and repetitive factual recitals of Dr. Sharlip's conduct which Plaintiff contends supports an award of punitive damages. These allegations were filed without obtaining a court order authorizing a claim for punitive damages against either Defendant. Given the court's ruling sustaining the demurrer as to the entire Second Amended Complaint, the motion to strike references to punitive damages in the SAC is moot. Nevertheless, the court admonishes Plaintiff that he is not to include references to punitive damages against either defendant in an amended pleading prior to seeking leave of court and an order authorizing the filing of a punitive damages claim against a health care provider as required by CCP 425.13(a).
